description: Framed posters down both walls, one for every season the Palais has been open. The newest are photographs. The oldest are hand-lettered, and the ink has gone the colour of tea.

flags.examine_detail: The one nearest the door is from the opening season. The top line is a dance band, the prices are in a currency the city stopped using, and at the bottom it promises that the Palais will never close. So far it hasn't.

name: the old bills
